name: agy_write_two_alias_paths
description: One write naming two different files under alias keys. The canonicaliser must not choose one: measured 2026-11-09, the map-iteration version produced two different results from 500 identical calls (402 / 98), so identical bytes could be denied and allowed. Every distinct value is placed on a canonical key the policies already match, so the context-files rule sees the AGENTS.md candidate. The escalation is emitted as force_ask for this dialect.

capture.sanitisation: session ids, transcript paths, model names and tool_use ids replaced with cap-* placeholders; tool names and parameter names and their casing are exactly as emitted
capture.note: synthetic values in a real Antigravity envelope shape; no capture contains two path aliases, so this case pins the handler, not an observed harness behaviour
